artifacts.description: 9 components: db, auth, auth-middleware, tasks, context, memory, bridge, server, cli. Risk tiers: 4x T1, 3x T2, 1x T3.
artifacts.consumer_input_mapping: Components with risk_tier in (T1, T2) are eligible for the focused picks. Component 'state' must be CLEAR (not UNCLEAR). Use 'test_boundary' to decide which test layer to extend.

artifacts.description: 10 gaps: 4 P0, 3 P1, 3 P2. P0 are all auth-surface issues. Top 5 by priority: CTA-GAP-001 (auth password validation), CTA-GAP-002 (middleware expired session), CTA-GAP-008 (XSS in server.js), CTA-GAP-009 (auth session expiration policy), CTA-GAP-003 (middleware malformed cookie).
artifacts.consumer_input_mapping: Filter gaps by priority in (P0, P1) AND risk in (T1, T2). Take top MAX_FILES_PER_BATCH (default 5). For each gap, set 'source_file' as the test file path, run targeted test, parse coverage delta from coverage-final.json (Istanbul 1.0).

artifacts.description: Per-component behavioral coverage with explicit gaps. CLI is honestly 0% with a 'subprocess execution' gap reason. 5 of 9 components at 100%.
artifacts.consumer_input_mapping: Reference for human review. Coverage workflow does not consume this directly.

artifacts.description: 12 dependencies classified by type, failure impact, likelihood. T1 risks: bcrypt, helmet. T2 risks: better-sqlite3, ws, express-rate-limit, DOMPurify, fs. Mostly T3-T4.
artifacts.consumer_input_mapping: For each gap, look up the dependency's test_strategy. 'Real' = use real in-memory or Testcontainers equivalent. The CTI repo uses better-sqlite3, so the test setup should use ':memory:' SQLite.

artifacts.description: 4 components with non-trivial state machines: auth, tasks, bridge, context. 27 transitions total. Coverage requirements listed per transition.
artifacts.consumer_input_mapping: Use the transition matrix to design new tests for the gaps. E.g. CTA-GAP-001 (auth validation) needs tests for the 'Registered→Authenticated' and 'SessionExpired→Authenticated' transitions.

artifacts.description: 15 contracts (14 HTTP + 1 WebSocket). All documented from source inspection. No OpenAPI/Swagger file exists. WebSocket contract (CTA-CTC-015) is not exercised by the test suite (CTA-GAP-004).
artifacts.consumer_input_mapping: Use contracts to write supertest-based integration tests. Each contract's auth_required field tells you whether to include a session cookie.

artifacts.description: Components ranked by composite risk. server is P0 (score 26), auth and auth-middleware are P1 (22, 21). Most are P2 (13-17 range). CLI is P3 (14).
artifacts.consumer_input_mapping: Sort gaps by their component's priority. Fix P0 first (server), then P1 (auth, auth-middleware), then P2 in order. CLI (P3) is the lowest-priority work.
